event: Community decimated in rioting by the local populace during the Ottoman conquest transition; cut from ~20 families to 8-10.
mechanism: conquest-transition riot

event: Pogrom on a false rumor of Ottoman defeat during the Mamluk-Ottoman transition; Jews evicted, robbed, 'fled naked to the villages.'
quote: evicted from their homes, robbed, and plundered, and they fled naked to the villages, without any provisions
perp: local populace at a power vacuum
mechanism: dhimmi soft target at breakdown of order
src: David 1999, To Come to the Land (contemporary Hebrew source), david_1999.txt L4149-52

event: Knights of Malta capture ships of Safed-bound Jewish migrants; 10,000-zecchino ransom; captives 'stripped to the skin.'
mechanism: defenseless-minority-as-prey en route to Palestine

event: Murad III surgun firman ordering the 1,000 wealthiest Jewish families deported to repopulate Cyprus (reduced to 500, then rescinded).
mechanism: Jews treated as disposable, relocatable population

event: Egyptian Jewish pilgrims ordered expelled within 15 days.
mechanism: administrative expulsion

event: Main (Ramban) synagogue confiscated; Jews barred from a public synagogue for decades.
mechanism: religious-site confiscation

event: Anti-Jewish brigandage during Fakhr al-Din II instability permanently empties the Jewish villages; yeshiva relocated.
mechanism: prey at breakdown of order

event: Druze (Ma'an faction) massacre; mass flight to Damascus; by 1653 Safed 'practically devoid of Jews.'
mechanism: factional massacre + flight

event: Governor Muhammad ibn Farrukh raids the synagogue on the Sabbath, takes 15 hostages, stages mock executions; 11,000-grush ransom; community forced to borrow ~50,000, guards prevent flight.
mechanism: hostage-taking + extortion

event: Kadi extorts 500 gurus from imprisoned Jewish leaders.
mechanism: judicial extortion

event: Ashkenazi collective-debt crisis; synagogue closed; ~400 of 700 famished.
mechanism: collective-debt enforcement + famine

event: Extortion 'so high the elders could not raise it, and many prominent scholars had to flee.'
mechanism: extortion -> flight

event: Culminating a 25,000-kurus debt spiral (1690s-1720), Muslim creditors burn the Ashkenazi compound and synagogue (the Hurva); Ashkenazim excluded / forced to pass as Sephardim for ~116 years.
mechanism: legal debt-enforcement against a defenseless collective

event: New governor demands 91,000 kurus within 91 days; arrests community official R. Moses Meyuhas.
mechanism: fiscal extraction under duress

event: Burial ban + extortion; 'Safed was an open city, and the peasants in the area could easily enter to rob and persecute the Jews.'
mechanism: open-city vulnerability + extortion

event: Extortion under Dahir al-Umar's son; 'terrors have overwhelmed us... we had to climb high mountains and hills to flee.'
mechanism: extortion -> flight

event: Expulsion attempts/plots ('bring in idol-worshippers in their place'); 1741 averted by bribe.
mechanism: expulsion plot, bribe-averted

event: Dual Muslim+Christian threat 'to destroy that people'; Jews 'delivered to cruel gentiles' who beat and wound them.
mechanism: communal threat + assault

event: 200+ flee 'in the night'; 'every day they take a person or a sage or a rich man and beat him until he gives them what they want.'
mechanism: chronic extortion -> flight

event: R. Azulay diary: 'the shaykhs of Yata and Samea persecuted us and demanded a large sum of money.'
mechanism: forced escort / road extortion

event: Blood-libel (a sheikh's son) -> 'many leave the country.'
mechanism: blood-libel -> flight

event: Jezzar 'the Butcher' Pasha regime: cizye raised ~fivefold (4,400->23,650), 'could now simply demand any sum he liked'; Farhi family mutilation; 1784 Tiberias grain-monopoly famine (prices +400%).
mechanism: predatory-pasha fiscal extraction + mutilation

event: Post-Napoleon collapse: Safed Jewish quarter 'completely sacked by the Turks, after the retreat of the French from Akka'; Jews across Palestine accused of collaborating with Napoleon and forced to pay bribes.
quote: the Jews quarter was completely sacked by the Turks, after the retreat of the French from Akka
mechanism: prey at collapse of order + accusation-extortion
src: Burckhardt 1822 p.317 (1812 visit); corpus inventory extortion-25

event: Murder of Haym Pharchi (Farhi), the Jewish court-agent/community-protector; his elimination opens a region-wide persecution.
mechanism: elimination of protector-figure

event: Rebels lock the Jews in their quarter and demand 'an immense sum of money'; total property surrendered under duress.
mechanism: revolt extortion under duress

event: ~33-day sack of the Jewish quarter by fellahin + trans-Jordan Bedouin during the anti-Egyptian Peasants' Revolt; synagogues desecrated, several slain, community impoverished; Druze rescue 22 Tamuz.
mechanism: collateral in the Peasants' Revolt, not primary target

event: Ibrahim Pasha's Egyptian troops storm and sack the rebel town; 'five Jews were purposely murdered,' all property stolen/destroyed; protective guard came 'too late.'
quote: five Jews were purposely murdered, and all their property stolen or destroyed in the most wanton and cruel manner
mechanism: military-sack license, not fellahin-revolt sack

event: Druze (anti-Egyptian Hauran revolt) plunder the already-devastated quarter, 'destroyed completely the last vestige of their prosperity' — the same Druze who had rescued the Jews in 1834.
mechanism: protection alliance-conditional, not essential

event: Sheikh Abd al-Rachman, 'a most insatiable leech,' chronic extraction (~5,000 piastres/yr protection money + 1852 ransom-or-expulsion threat) drove out most of Hebron's Jews.
mechanism: strongman protection-extraction (post-Egyptian decline)

event: Jews caught in factional warfare; the Pasha of Jerusalem storms the city; 'many were dangerously wounded... and deprived of all their property.'
mechanism: collateral in factional warfare

event: Bar-Giora founded (Shohat, Gil'adi, Zeid) — secret society for 'Hebrew labor' + Jewish guardianship of settlements.
mechanism: self-defense org founding (causation contested)
src: Morris RV L774 ('response') VS Shapira, Land and Power L3408-3420 ('independent of current events... internal developments')

event: HaShomer ('the guard') formed as the open armed arm of Bar-Giora; Morris ties it to 'increased Arab militancy after the Young Turks' revolt of July 1908.'
mechanism: self-defense org founding (causation contested)
src: Morris RV L774-776 VS Shapira L3413-3420

event: HaShomer's offensive/provocative 'conquest groups' occupy newly-bought land; guards demanded dismissal of Arab workers; village headmen accused them of theft/murder; Tolkovsky feared paying for 'unnecessary provocations.'
mechanism: conquest-of-guarding / displacement friction

event: New-Yishuv socialist settlement repeatedly attacked: 1 killed Dec 1919, 1 Feb 1920, then 1 Mar 1920 battle killed 6 defenders incl. Trumpeldor + 2 women; settlement torched, resettled Oct 1920.
mechanism: settlers caught in Franco-Arab-British panhandle contest; decision to HOLD was ideological
src: Morris RV pp.90-96; Shapira; Porath vol.1 (omits Tel Hai entirely)

location: Jerusalem Old City Jewish Quarter + Jaffa Road
event: Nebi Musa/Passover riots: 6 Jews killed, 200+ injured, several synagogues destroyed; victims predominantly Old-Yishuv (Old City religious, largely non-/anti-Zionist); mob incited from the procession (Musa Kazim al-Husseini, 'Arif al-'Arif), chants 'Nashrab dam al-Yahud'/'Itbah al-Yahud.'
quote: Palestine is our land and the Jews are our dogs / Nashrab dam al-Yahud (we will drink the blood of the Jews)
mechanism: mob-form categorical + geographic accessibility of Old Yishuv; British protection failure (Storrs withdrew Indian troops, barred Jewish relief; Jabotinsky 15 yrs)
src: Morris RV L1134-1150; Palin Report; Sakakini diary

event: Haganah founded after Tel Hai + Nebi Musa + 'a sobering awakening from the illusory hopes placed in the British administration.'
quote: Inexplicably, that night Governor Storrs ordered the Indian troops to leave the Old City
mechanism: violence-triggered founding + British protection-failure co-trigger
src: Shapira L6011-6024; Morris RV L1148, L1316-1318

event: Riot triggered by a Jewish COMMUNIST (MOPS, anti-Zionist) vs Ahdut haAvoda May Day clash; mob attack on an immigrants' hostel in Ajami (13 killed, 26 wounded); Abu Kabir orange grove 6 killed incl. Y.C. Brenner; aggregate 47 Jews killed / 146 wounded, 48 Arabs killed.
quote: thirteen Jews were killed and twenty-six wounded—shot, stabbed, and bludgeoned
perp: Arab mob (+ Arab police participating); rural spread by plunder/false rumor
mechanism: soft-target = new immigrants; rural spread 'not so much by nationalist slogans as by false rumours the Jews were slaughtering Arabs' + plunder
src: Morris RV L1182-1190; Porath vol.1 p.161; Survey of Palestine 1946 p.18

event: Settlement attacks: Petach Tikva preplanned dawn assault (2,000-3,000), 4 Jewish defenders killed / 28 attackers dead by RAF; Hadera routed by aircraft ('No Jews were hurt'); Rehovot repulsed by the Haganah 'without British help,' no casualties.
mechanism: defense + British protection correlated with survival; Rehovot = organized Jewish self-defense sufficed alone

event: Balfour-anniversary clashes: 5 Jews + 3 Arabs killed; al-Nadi al-'Arabi extremists; named by Tahir al-Husayni's 1925 admission as the second Hajj-Amin-organized episode.
mechanism: Balfour-anniversary categorical clash
src: Morris RV L1192; Porath vol.1 p.161

event: Rabbi Ya'akov Yisrael de Haan, a Haredi anti-Zionist lobbying against Jewish rule, assassinated by the Haganah.
mechanism: Zionist camp violently suppressed anti-Zionist Old-Yishuv holdouts

event: Pre-1929 Mizrahi/Sephardi had ~0 members in the Haganah and lived culturally as Arabs; 'Beginning in 1929 the Sephardim began joining the Haganah' after 'The Arabs began to do with the Sephardim what they did with us.'
quote: There were no members of the Sephardi community in the Haganah. The Sephardim did not mix with the Ashkenazim
mechanism: absorption of non-Zionist Mizrahi into Zionist defense as a RESULT of violence — the reverse arrow
src: Shevah Yekutieli, HHA 103/23 (Sept 1970), via Cohen l.1006-1008

event: Yitzhak Sadeh's Haganah force ran motorized incursions into Arab neighborhoods, shooting into crowds; testimony: they 'made no distinction between assailants and innocent passersby.'
quote: made no distinction between assailants and innocent passersby
mechanism: symmetric Jewish-side categorical targeting of Arab civilians
src: Levi Avrahami, HHA 74/66, 2/7, via Cohen l.2392

event: Mohammad Jaber + Sur Baher villagers extract 4 Jewish quarry workers dressed as Arabs, fighting an armed Arab en route; their guide later shot dead on his return.
mechanism: village-level rescue at lethal cost to the rescuer — distinction held

event: Jews rescued Arabs from Jewish mobs: Ezra Kiryati (Haganah + Mandate policeman) extracted an Arab family's children on horseback; a Jewish grocer saved his Arab neighbor; Arab porter Khamis Salem al-Sayyed sheltered by a Jewish household (distinguishing 'the people of the house' from the 'Zionist Jews' who chased him).
mechanism: symmetric rescue mirror; distinction held from both sides

event: Naftali Rubenshtein, a 23-yr-old Polish Jew and British police officer 'until 1929, when he joined the Haganah,' attacked an unsuspecting group of Arab workers on hearing of the Hebron massacre; sentenced to 3 years.
mechanism: mobilization-into-defense that spilled into retaliation

event: 133 Jews killed / 241 wounded vs 116 Arabs killed / 232 wounded (British counted by RELIGION); most Jewish dead unarmed, murdered in homes; victims came 'largely from the long-established Mizrahi, Maghrebi, and religious communities that predated the Zionist influx'; new Zionist settlements repelled attackers with the Haganah. Trials: 55 Arabs convicted of murder, 3 executed (17 Jun 1930); 2 Jews convicted, commuted.
quote: the victims of the 1929 massacres came largely from the ranks of the long-established Mizrahi, Maghrebi, and religious Jewish communities that predated the Zionist influx
mechanism: victim-selection inverse to affiliation — the master datum
src: Palestine Police 1929 report, TNA CO 814/4:22; Cohen, Year Zero intro (l.190)

event: Zionist settlement mounted a spirited defense against several thousand attackers, killing 40+, evacuated by British convoy, homes torched — a defended Zionist settlement survived without mass Jewish death.
mechanism: defended Zionist settlement survived (contrast with undefended Old Yishuv)

event: Har-Tuv, Emeq Arazim, Migdal-Eder, Kfar Uriah, Be'er Tuvia abandoned/burned; Gedera saved by British troops Aug 27; several sets of inhabitants SAVED by Arab neighbors (Migdal-Eder by Bayt Ummar; Kfar Uriah by the mukhtar of Bayt Far).
mechanism: outcome tracked local security/leadership, not affiliation

event: Valley settlements attacked (25 wounded, 0 killed at Beisan); Arab police PROTECTED Jews in Lydda (and Acre, Gaza) and restrained hotheads.
mechanism: protection tracked local power-configuration/leadership, not Jewish affiliation

event: Mukhtar Avraham Haim Tzuri's house attacked (Arabic-speaking, children in Arab schools, Zionist-connected) AND Mr. Farji (no Zionist ties, kept his distance from all Jews, city councilman) — both attacked despite maximal assimilation. Intra-Arab split: Sheikh As'ad al-Shuqayri (anti-Mufti) opposed violence, refused to organize anti-Wall demos; Arab police protected Jews.
mechanism: both the Zionist-linked and the non-Zionist assimilated Jew attacked — affiliation irrelevant at the mob level

event: The Maghrebi-origin Jewish community (settled from the 1880s under Hovevei Zion's Aharon Amoyal) was evacuated, ending the Gaza Jewish community — a pre-Zionist Arab-Jewish community destroyed (Arab police had restrained attackers).
mechanism: pre-Zionist community destroyed

event: The only Holy City with no Jewish blood shed: joint Jewish-Arab leadership appeal for calm (Maghrebi rabbis Zrihan & Vaknin, Jewish mayor Zaki Alhadif, Ashkenazi rep, Muslim notables incl. mufti Tabari); police commander Tzvi Shapira defended settlements with Jewish/Christian police + one loyal Muslim sergeant.
mechanism: distinction held; joint communal leadership + local security prevented violence — outcome tracked leadership not affiliation
src: Cohen (Sefer Teveriah, Avisar 1973) l.2548; HHA 180/11 l.2550

event: ~60-67 Jews killed, overwhelmingly unarmed Old-Yishuv Orthodox (Slabodka yeshiva students, elderly rabbis, Arabic-speaking Sephardim, women & children); only 1 gun (Slonim's). Community explicitly non-/anti-Zionist (Chabad + Sephardi; 1904 refused a Herzl memorial); rejected Haganah protection (Aug 20 offer + a 12-man armed detachment turned away by Slonim). 24 killed in the Slonim house; Slonim refused to surrender the yeshiva 'foreigners.' Incitement PRIORITIZED integrated local Jews (Sheikh Marka: 'slaughter them first'); failed native pleas (Kapiluto, Abushedid); Cafferata testimony (child beheading; off-duty Arab constable Issa Sherif).
quote: the community rejected both ideas, saying that they trusted the town's a'yan to protect them
perp: Hebron Arab mob; incited by Sheikh Taleb Maraqa
mechanism: least-Zionist targeted; targeting inverted the Zionist/non-Zionist distinction; mob-form + geographic accessibility
src: Morris RV p.115; Schwartz/Halevi, Ghosts; Cohen, Year Zero; Sefer Hevron; Shaw Commission 2:985 (Cafferata)

event: 31 Jews killed / 119 wounded (50 Arabs killed, mostly by British/Haganah fire); first fatalities in the Old-Yishuv Georgian (Gurji) and Bukharan quarters (first fatality Aug 17: Avraham Mizrahi, Bukharan). Meah She'arim defended by a Haganah squad (~16 men, one pistol) incl. Moshe Alperstein / R. Aharon Fisher (a Haredi anti-Zionist); most of Jerusalem's Jews did not defend themselves.
mechanism: first dead in Old-Yishuv Sephardi/Bukharan/Georgian quarters
src: Palestine Police table (Cohen); Morris p.114; Cohen; Segev

event: ~24 Arab families rescued ~250 Jews (Filastin claims 350); named clans (Abu Haikal, Abu Zina, Kurdiyya saved the Schneursons, etc.); ~75-yr-old Abu Shaker 'Amru barred the mob at the Slonim door, was knifed, called 'traitor' ('Only over my dead body will you pass').
quote: at least 250 Jews were rescued by their Arab neighbors... some two dozen Arab families risked their lives to save at least half the Jews in Hebron
mechanism: distinction HELD person-by-person; protection tracked local relationship, not affiliation; rioter's epithet for the rescuer was 'traitor' (attack = norm)

event: Makleff family on the settlement edge largely killed (Rabbi Shach murdered); but those who fetched 10 armed Haganah the night before and gathered in one house survived; child Mordechai Maklef (future IDF chief of staff) spared.
mechanism: defense-as-response: those who followed instructions and gathered survived

event: A Jewish group led by policeman Simha Hinkis broke into the home of Sheikh 'Abd al-Ghani 'Awn, imam of Abu Kabir, killing him and family members incl. a woman and a 3-year-old — a reprisal after Hebron; ~20 of the 116 Arab dead countrywide were killed in Jewish reprisals/British fire.
mechanism: symmetric Jewish-side categorical reprisal against Arab civilians qua Arabs
src: al-Dabbagh 2002 4:265 + Sefer Toldot HaHaganah; Cohen l.356,434

event: 20 Jews killed (+2 by British fire), ~80 wounded; overwhelmingly Old-Yishuv/Sephardi community (~3,000 among ~10,000 Arabs); 3 more killed at adjacent Ein Zeitim. Mazal Cohen among the dead (brother's Davar eulogy = coexistence valedictory); Moshe & Frieda Afriyat murdered by Fuad Hijazi, a Jesuit-educated 'loyal nationalist' (only Safed perpetrator hanged, 17 Jun 1930).
mechanism: Old-Yishuv/Sephardi targeted; 'natives-not-Zionists' framing failed
src: Morris p.116; Cohen, Year Zero; Davar Oct 13 1929 + Aug 14 1930

event: Attempted assassination of Norman Bentwich (British Jewish Attorney-General) — he survived; the ONLY selective attack on a Jewish leadership figure across 1917-48.
mechanism: violence did NOT target Zionist political leadership; even the one selective exception was a British official

event: Meir Abu (old Safed Jewish family) + Na'if Subh (Arab mayor) attempt to found a local 'Brit Shalom' reconciliation body post-massacre.
mechanism: post-violence reconciliation initiative — distinction held

event: Irgun Bet founded by Haganah officers who 'wanted the Haganah to abandon its defensive strategy and take an aggressive, retaliatory line' (post-1929 riots + havlaga dissatisfaction); renamed Irgun Zvai Leumi (IZL) Apr 1937 (Revisionist military wing).
mechanism: violence-triggered founding (1929) + havlaga dissatisfaction
src: Morris RV L1328; Cohen, Year Zero L736

event: Notrim / Jewish Settlement Police created ('a scheme put into effect during 1936'; before 1936 'there were no supernumerary or other Jewish settlement police'); 2,700 active supernumeraries by 1937; British-armed, concentrated on settlement defense + road patrol.
quote: Before 1936 there were no supernumerary or other Jewish settlement police
mechanism: direct response to the Revolt's ambush tactics; British-sanctioned defense of exactly the attacked targets
src: Survey of Palestine 1946 L30258-30310; Morris RV L1430; Shapira L11773-11778

event: 3 Jewish drivers shot at an Arab roadblock, 'first victims of the revolt.'
mechanism: road/convoy target, not affiliation-sorted
src: Morris RV ~p.129; Survey 1946 p.34; Porath vol.2 p.162

event: Two days after the first three Jewish drivers were shot, Irgun Bet men shot dead two Arab occupants of a shack in revenge.
mechanism: reactive-retaliation/offense at Revolt onset

event: Opening pogrom: 9 Jews killed / ~60 wounded, thousands of Jaffa Jews fled to Tel Aviv; 8 more killed in reciprocal mixed-quarter attacks.
mechanism: urban mob, whole Jewish presence / mixed-quarter target

event: Gunman fired on a Jewish crowd leaving a cinema, 3 killed, 2 wounded.
mechanism: indiscriminate Jews-as-such

location: Jaffa hospital / Mount Carmel / Tel Aviv
event: Two Jewish nurses murdered at the Jaffa government hospital (Aug 17), four Jews murdered in the Mount Carmel forests, a child murdered in Tel Aviv — triggering the Haganah's brief mid-Aug deviation from havlaga, then a reaffirmation of restraint.
mechanism: civilian/workplace targets; triggered the havlaga policy debate

event: Arab Revolt Jewish-dead aggregate: 429-547 total (5-source convergent), annual ~80 / ~70 / 255 / 94 (1936/1937/1938/1939); 1937 composition 438 rebel attacks (109 anti-British, 143 anti-Jewish-settlement, 109 anti-'Arab houses'), ~25% intra-Arab; ~60-78 armed/police dead, ~350-480 civilians. Zionist/non-Zionist victim disaggregation structurally UNAVAILABLE.
mechanism: targeting sorts by geography/strategy (roads, settlements, quarters) — consistent with 'Jews qua Jews' but victim-affiliation decoupling is untestable
src: Survey of Palestine 1946 pp.38-48; Hughes 2019 App.B p.384; Morris RV; Porath vol.2

event: 5 kibbutz workers murdered (killers traced to Qatanna).
mechanism: settlement-labor target

event: Irgun mass-casualty market bombings ('Day of Breaking the Havlaga' Nov 11/14 1937; Haifa 21 killed Jul 6; Haifa 39+ Jul 25; Jaffa 24 Aug 26; Jerusalem 10) — ~96 Arab civilians.
quote: the Day of the Breaking of the Havlaga (restraint) ... for the first time massive bombs were placed in crowded Arab centers
mechanism: symmetric Jewish-side CATEGORICAL anti-Arab targeting; offense not defense; Morris's 'innovation' matching Arab pogrom numbers

event: The Husseini network selectively assassinated Palestinian moderates (Hasan Sidqi al-Dajani, Rafe' al-Fahoum, Anwar Shuqayri, the Irsheid brothers, Nassir al-Din) — individuated targeting for intra-Palestinian targets, categorical/mob form for Jews.
mechanism: asymmetry: selective-targeting CAPABILITY existed but was applied categorically to Jews-as-collective, never to Zionist leadership
src: Cohen, Army of Shadows p.133; Mattar

event: FOSH (plugot sadeh / field squads) formed under Yitzhak Sadeh because 'passive guard duty behind a perimeter fence' had no answer to ambushes.
mechanism: response to Revolt ambushes; marks the pivot to offensive doctrine

event: Special Night Squads (SNS) set up by Capt. Charles Orde Wingate (~60 British + ~100 Jews) to guard the Iraq-Haifa pipeline and punish saboteurs; killed ~60 Arabs in the first month, incl. retaliatory village raids.
mechanism: Revolt-response, but explicitly offensive/retaliatory

event: Community massacre: 19 Jews killed incl. 11 children, synagogue torched, curate murdered; a mixed religious+secular neighborhood — 'raiders did not interrogate theological positions.' The one Revolt episode with likely Old-Yishuv over-representation.
mechanism: killed qua Jews, not sorted by theology/affiliation
src: Morris RV p.159; JA report via Segev p.414

event: Targeted assassination of Jewish mayor Zaki Alhadif (Sephardi, Va'ad-Leumi civic officeholder).
mechanism: killed for unified-Yishuv civic role, not theology — the Va'ad Leumi unification made a Sephardi a target qua Jewish-civic-representative

event: Lehi (Stern Gang) split from the Irgun over CONTINUING to fight Britain during WWII; no Arab-violence trigger; Stern even sought an anti-British alliance with Nazi Germany.
mechanism: a Jewish armed org NOT formed in response to Arab violence — inverts the pattern toward Britain

event: Palmach (plugot mahatz) established by the Haganah with British assistance (Sadeh) — dual purpose: 'instantly available crack force to fend off Arab attacks and a commando unit to be used against the Nazis.'
mechanism: WWII-strategic (Axis-invasion fear) as much as Arab-defense; Revolt-rooted but not triggered by a specific Arab-violence round

event: 1947-48 anti-Jewish-violence ledger: 126 distinct events; settlement assault 58 (46%), convoy/traffic ambush 28 (22%), urban bombing 10, sniping 9, assassination 9, siege 7, riot 5; ~1,390 Jewish dead (indicative). Targets = Zionist settlement + road infrastructure.
mechanism: RECOUPLING at the level of what-was-attacked; by 1947-48 Zionist affiliation is near-universal (a non-varying variable) — weak decoupling evidence

event: Convoy war: Etzion 11 Dec (10 dead), Ben-Shemen 14 Dec (14), Lamed-Heh 15-16 Jan (35 Hebrew-U students), Yehiam 27 Mar (47), Nabi Daniyal 27 Mar (15 dead/73 wnd), Hulda 31 Mar (22).
mechanism: target = Zionist supply lines / colonization-front infrastructure — recoupling

event: 39 Jewish (mostly white-collar) co-workers massacred by Arab co-workers, ~50 wounded (triggered by an IZL bomb).
mechanism: categorical workplace massacre qua Jews; IZL-bomb trigger (reciprocal)

event: Car-bomb, 58 killed 'almost all civilians,' 32 wounded — the war's worst attack to date.
mechanism: urban categorical civilian attack

event: Hadassah medical convoy, 78 killed 'mostly unarmed lecturers, students, nurses and doctors,' many roasted alive (retaliation after Deir Yassin).
mechanism: convoy/civilians; recoupled-phase, part of the reprisal cycle

event: Counter-current: Arab Legion conduct 'exemplary [hayta lemofet]... great civility'; a POW: 'they protected us even from the mob... they themselves carried the stretchers.'
quote: the Arab Legion protected the prisoners, even from the mob
mechanism: a disciplined STATE ARMY re-differentiated from the mob — protection tracked the actor's character/power-config, not any Jewish attribute

event: ~150 killed; after surrender 'almost all the men and women were murdered' (106 men + 27 women), militiamen shouting 'Deir Yassin'; 357 POWs from 3 other bloc kibbutzim to Transjordan.
mechanism: target = a Zionist bloc (recoupling); surrender-massacre in the Deir Yassin reprisal cycle

event: Inhabitants 'almost all ultra-Orthodox,' 'on good terms with their Arab neighbours,' 'loath to see their homes sacrificed to Zionist heroics'; 213 defenders -> 39 dead, 134 wounded; 290 male POWs (two-thirds noncombatants) + 51 wounded to Mafraq; ~1,200 civilians expelled via Zion Gate; Hurva synagogue blown up 26-27 May; Quarter judenrein until 1967.
mechanism: the archetypal ANTI-ZIONIST community pulled in and cleared qua Jews — the decisive 1948 datum
src: Morris, 1948 pp.219, L11266-71; Kurzman, Genesis 1948 pp.392-93
